# TF2 Bot Detector 1.7.0.6

Community-maintained revival build from the Newport1 fork.

## Downloads

- **Windows x64 (recommended):** [tf2-bot-detector_windows-x64_1.7.0.6.zip](https://github.com/Newport1/tf2_bot_detector/releases/download/v1.7.0.6/tf2-bot-detector_windows-x64_1.7.0.6.zip)
- **Windows x86:** [tf2-bot-detector_windows-x86_1.7.0.6.zip](https://github.com/Newport1/tf2_bot_detector/releases/download/v1.7.0.6/tf2-bot-detector_windows-x86_1.7.0.6.zip)
- **Linux x86_64 AppImage:** [tf2-bot-detector_linux-x86_64_1.7.0.6.AppImage](https://github.com/Newport1/tf2_bot_detector/releases/download/v1.7.0.6/tf2-bot-detector_linux-x86_64_1.7.0.6.AppImage)
- **Linux x86_64 portable:** [tf2-bot-detector_linux-x86_64_1.7.0.6.zip](https://github.com/Newport1/tf2_bot_detector/releases/download/v1.7.0.6/tf2-bot-detector_linux-x86_64_1.7.0.6.zip)
- **SHA-256 checksums:** [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/Newport1/tf2_bot_detector/releases/download/v1.7.0.6/SHA256SUMS.txt)

## Highlights

- Current Newport1 `custom` branch compatibility work for modern TF2/Windows.
- Linux build and AppImage support.
- Faster loading of very large third-party player lists such as the historical SteamRep list.
- Avoids unnecessary normalization/reserialization of successfully loaded third-party configs.
- Moves parsed third-party player maps instead of copying the full map.
- Correctly counts third-party player entries rather than counting third-party list files.

## Build provenance

The downloadable binaries are taken from the successful GitHub Actions **1.7.0.6 Release** builds associated with PR #6 (`perf/large-third-party-playerlists`). Windows and Linux CI both completed successfully before publication.

This is a community-maintained continuation build and is not an official release from the archived upstream PazerOP repository.
